ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift
ordered_steps.summary: Audit and document schema drift in the translator before removing the legacy parser shim. This reduces ambiguity about what the translator produces.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report identifying differences between current translator output and expected step-id schema

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Update dependency-graph fixtures so the plan contract catches ordering regressions when new step ids are introduced.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated fixtures in tests/plan_contract.py that pass with new step ids

ordered_steps.title: Enable dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the translated release-plan dashboard summary behind a kill switch after the schema is stable and fixtures are in place.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature flag enabled in canary with kill switch available

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update the operator runbook and launch checklist after the summary path is proven in canary.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Updated runbook documenting rollout and rollback procedures

dependency_notes.reason: Translator schema must be audited and stabilized before fixtures can be correctly updated
Dashboard summary depends on step-id schema and fixtures; fixtures must reflect new schema before dashboard can render correctly
Runbook requires knowledge of rollout and rollback shape which is only known after dashboard is proven in canary

primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect or unstable step ordering to users if schema drift is not audited and fixtures are not updated before enabling the summary
mitigations: Audit schema drift first (RN-101) to understand what the translator actually produces
Backfill fixtures (RN-102) before enabling dashboard to ensure plan contract catches ordering issues
Use kill switch (RN-103) to disable dashboard quickly if issues appear in canary
Keep legacy parser shim in place until schema audit is complete

assumption_ledger.note: No explicit release note for removing the shim; audit (RN-101) must inform whether removal is safe
Kill switch infrastructure needs verification for RN-103
Canary deployment path needs verification for RN-103 and RN-104 validation
